kind: multi-node execution coordinator and CPU software verification; no new scientific RLVR measurements
user_instruction: 야 노드 여러개 잡으면 더 빨리 되게 해
hypothesis: Independent seed/branch/evaluation tasks can fill multiple 4GPU nodes without duplicate execution or premature freeze/evaluation, while retaining the existing scientific task definitions and recovery artifacts.

method.scheduling: one four-GPU torchrun job per node/GPU group; shared-filesystem dynamic queue; immutable per-task matrices; per-task leases; globally serialized control actions
method.dependency: dispatch checkpoint-ready branches before trajectory completion; freeze only after all training outputs and leases are complete
method.recovery: retained attempts/failures; inherited job/GPU lock descriptors; SIGTERM checkpoint path; no age-based lease stealing
method.identity: same coordinator/runner/config/trainer hashes, Python/package versions and per-seed input hashes; validate run and evaluation artifact identity
method.evaluation: freeze cost-only budget before evaluation, then per-seed bundle and checkpoint/protocol lease; no periodic held-out evaluation added

data_model_transformation.data: synthetic ToyBackend generated features/answers; actual V8 planner/runner/evaluator
data_model_transformation.model: CPU ToyBackend; no language model training
data_model_transformation.production_scope: existing OLMo MATH and Qwen MBPP rebuttal_bank seeds5–9; original H275/safety400 config preserved

controls: three and six simulated node processes
GPU overlap across cohorts rejected before model launch

metric_definitions.tasks: distinct full task identity with validated terminal outputs; every dispatched attempt retained
metric_definitions.duplicate_execution: more than one actual execution record for one task identity
metric_definitions.concurrency: overlap of CPU attempt start/end timestamps on the same local host; not H100 throughput
metric_definitions.training_reward: recorded per-update training-batch reward, separate from held-out evaluator
metric_definitions.heldout: question-level integer correctness/response denominator tied to checkpoint and protocol; skipped intermediate held-out values remain unmeasured

integration.scope: CPU multi-process software integration; not scientific RLVR results

software_results.note: Final portable test fixture repeats70 passing checks on identical coordinator code; metadata/raw manifest retain the preceding matching70-pass integration run.

scientific_measurements.cross_node_network_filesystem_locks: not tested on actual allocated nodes

notes: Initial FakeRuntime binding omitted cohort; test-only fixture corrected.
Initial orphan recovery assertion incorrectly demanded retry priority over never-attempted work; corrected to scheduler policy.
integration-first basetemp parent did not yet exist:26 setup errors; created report root, kept raw XML.
integration-fourth/fifth used100/200/300 slices of only100 questions; fixture corrected to100/70/40.

provenance.checkpoints: 43 CPU .pt files, including prefixes/latest/retained snapshots, hashed in raw manifest and preserved locally
provenance.training_logs: runs/*/training_stats.jsonl and history.jsonl included; attempt events remain at raw integration root
provenance.publication_note: Git source/metadata publication only; no website deployment or GPU job launch performed

limitations: Requires the same shared V8_ROOT absolute path and functioning cross-node POSIX flock.
Do not mix old full rebuttal loops with new coordinator on the same root.
Independent jobs parallelize; one optimizer is not split across nodes.
Only existing rebuttal Branch Bank path is supported; new-seed tune-freeze/E8 scaffolds remain outside this change.
No linear speedup claim; actual H100 progress/performance is unmeasured.
